project_type: Greenfield AWS monorepo: CloudFormation infra + FastAPI (uvicorn) backend container + static-exported Next.js SPA frontend
language: YAML (CloudFormation), Python 3.12 (backend, in Docker), TypeScript/React (Next.js frontend)
build_system: Backend: Docker image build (python:3.12-slim base) with uv/pip for deps. Frontend: npm + next build with output:'export'. Infra: CloudFormation templates validated with `aws cloudformation validate-template` if AWS CLI available, otherwise with cfn-lint / YAML parse.
test_command: Backend: pytest in backend/ (runs on host with Python 3.12 via pyenv, or in container). Frontend: next lint / tsc --noEmit. Infra: cfn-lint templates or python yaml.safe_load parse check.
build_command: Backend: docker build -t course-backend backend/. Frontend: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build (produces out/). Infra: no build; validate templates.
verification_instructions: 1) Parse every CloudFormation YAML template with a YAML+CFN loader and confirm no errors; run cfn-lint if installed. 2) Confirm cross-stack/cross-file consistency: bucket names, container port, env var names, Cognito output names, CloudFront path behavior /api/*, ALB health check path all line up between infra, backend, and frontend. 3) Backend: pip install deps in a venv (python3.12) and run pytest; confirm /hello requires JWT and health endpoint is public. 4) docker build the backend image succeeds. 5) Frontend: npm ci && npm run build succeeds and produces a static export in out/.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Frontend `frontend/out/` is generated by `next build` (gitignored). No committed generated files.
setup_instructions: Local Python is 3.9; use pyenv to select 3.12 for backend host testing, or test inside Docker. Node v22 is default and suitable for Next.js. Docker is available for backend image build. AWS CLI deployment is NOT run in this environment; deliverable is valid, self-consistent source + templates.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (package installs and doc fetches allowed). Docker available for image build. AWS deploy is NOT executed here. cfn-lint may need `pip install cfn-lint`. Host python default 3.9 — backend targets 3.12, prefer container or pyenv 3.12 for host test runs.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Python .gitignore already in repo. Keep everything in the monorepo: infra/, backend/, frontend/. Region is us-east-1. Google is the ONLY IdP via Cognito Managed Login (OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE); no native username/password users and no in-app credential form.
key_patterns: CloudFormation split into logical stacks under infra/: network+security (VPC/ALB/WAF), storage (S3+CloudFront), auth (Cognito), compute (ECR/ECS Fargate SPOT). Use Parameters for deploy-time values (Google client id/secret, ACM cert/domain optional, image tag). Use Outputs to wire stacks together (Export/ImportValue) OR a single parent template with nested/cross-referenced resources. S3 bucket name uses a stack-derived unique suffix via !Select/!Split on AWS::StackId so it is repeatable without hardcoding.
relevant_files: backend/app/auth.py (Cognito JWT verification via JWKS - to create)
frontend/ (Next.js static export SPA - to create)
directory_structure: infra/ = CloudFormation YAML templates (one per logical stack) + README with deploy order and parameters. backend/ = FastAPI service (app/ package, Dockerfile, pyproject/requirements, tests/). frontend/ = Next.js app (app/ or pages/, next.config.js with output:'export', auth helper for Cognito Managed Login PKCE, package.json).
